# Is the consumer engine of the economy starting to slow down?

Consumer sentiment tumbled in early August, according to the University of Michigan survey. July retail sales were down more than half a percent from June, and AAA reports the nationwide average gas price neared a record high for August.

Economyby Mitchell Hartman

Download [...] Consumer sentiment took a tumble in early August, according to preliminary results for the University of Michigan’s survey for the month, driven principally by rising energy prices as the war in Iran heated up. July retail sales were pretty lousy — down more than half a percent from June.

results.content:
The week concludes with the University of Michigan's final Consumer Sentiment reading for August. Preliminary sentiment fell sharply to 51.0 from 55.2 in July, while year-ahead inflation expectations edged up to 4.3%.
